status: WT lane 2026-11-22: whole-villa walkthrough; registered before any villa frame was rendered
walking_height_basis: ASSUMED conservative camera-operator envelope, not an architectural standard
motion_basis: ASSUMED slow walkthrough camera operation; no published speed or yaw standard claimed

sample_difference.basis: ASSUMED image fidelity criterion, registered before measurements
sample_difference.metric: mean absolute RGB channel error in developed 8-bit PNG divided by 255, same camera, seed, exposure, white balance, full 1920x1080 frame
sample_difference.requirement: all three representative frames also pass unmodified render_qa

temporal_difference.basis: ASSUMED temporal noise criterion, registered before measurements
temporal_difference.metric: mean absolute RGB change between adjacent candidate frames on static opaque high-roughness surfaces reprojected using measured world position and first-hit position agreement within 0.03 m; reject disocclusion, four-pixel borders, depth edges, glass, emissive and unmatched pixels; RGB divided by 255; includes real view-dependent changes conservatively
temporal_difference.registration_revision: 2026-10-15 before any walkthrough image rendering or measurement: use actual reprojected candidate changes, avoiding an unnecessary 1024-sample reference for every final frame; threshold unchanged at 0.01
temporal_difference.coverage: every adjacent frame pair; insufficient valid static pixels refuses acceptance

exposure_scope: all 720 path frames; one complete-clip source population and one upper-median meter lock; no still-view lock reuse
final_gate: ~/archpipe/logs/render/finals.done must exist before final GPU work
maximum_speed_basis: Bohannon 1997, Age and Ageing 26(1):15-19, doi:10.1093/ageing/26.1.15: highest published mean comfortable gait speed 146.2 cm/s (men in their forties). Value taken from the abstract; full text not read.
cruise_speed_basis: Bohannon 1997 (as above): lowest published mean comfortable gait speed 127.2 cm/s (women in their seventies); chosen as the slowest cited walking pace, which suits a camera. Abstract only.
stair_speed_basis: ASSUMED slower pace on the flight; no source held
acceleration_basis: ASSUMED comfortable start/stop ramp; no source held
hold_basis: ASSUMED pause at a key view
stair_clearance_basis: ASSUMED: sweep box starts this far above the lower tread line so the next nosing (rise 0.176 m per 0.28 m going, up to 0.095 m inside the 0.15 m margin) is not a hit
transit_basis: a room narrower than twice the 0.30 m wall clearance cannot hold a standing point; it is crossed, not stood in
door_open_basis: ASSUMED swing angles tried in order; hinge side is not authored (except the core entrance) so the first collision-free option is used
maximum_yaw_rate_basis: ASSUMED slow camera pan (the earlier clip registered 20); 20 made the whole-villa pace 0.37 m/s on average because most rooms are small and need a 90-180 degree look-in
door_route_gap_basis: ASSUMED; 0.35 m keeps a leaf clear of the 0.30 m standing policy, 0.25 m is the fallback and the 0.15 m swept guard still decides at admission
